slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: How long a migration really takes

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: For around 50 users, budget roughly seven days of actual configuration work from us. Here is where that time goes.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: Before anything moves we find out what actually exists. How much mail and how many files, who owns the shared mailboxes nobody admits to using, which applications sign in with the old system, what state the devices are in. This is also where most nasty surprises get caught, while they are still cheap.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: We set up the new tenant properly, with security baselines, multi-factor authentication and licensing sorted from the start rather than retrofitted later. Then a small pilot group moves first. It is far better to find the awkward bits with four willing people than with all fifty at once.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Mail and files copy across in the background over several days while everyone carries on working in the old system. The switch itself is the short part, scheduled deliberately for a quiet window, followed by a few days of us being close by while people find the things only real use uncovers.
